title: Off By One
description: find_largest(numbers) should return the largest number in a non-empty list. It works sometimes... but not always.
hint: Which indexes does `range(len(numbers) - 1)` produce for a list of 3 items?
explanation: `range(n - 1)` stops at index `n - 2`, so the last element is never checked. The tests that pass all have their maximum somewhere else. Use `range(len(numbers))`, or better, loop over the values directly: `for number in numbers`.
